verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a cloud hosting platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no Railway capability for exporting all of a user's data (databases, volumes, configuration, logs) in open formats. The only migration evidence ('Migrate from Heroku') covers moving onto Railway, not leaving it. A community user's plan to migrate away does not show that any export feature exists.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
